title.hu: Harmadik feltételes mód (If I had known, I would have called)
title.en: The Third Conditional (If I had known, I would have called)
title.es: El tercer condicional (If I had known, I would have called)
title.de: Das dritte Konditional (If I had known, I would have called)

text.hu: A harmadik feltételes mód a múltról szól, ami már nem változtatható: if + past perfect, would have + igenév. „If I had known, I would have called you.” (Ha tudtam volna, felhívtalak volna.) A spanyol „Si lo hubiera sabido, te habría llamado” szerkezete pontosan ugyanez: a hubiera + igenév az if-mondatnak, a habría + igenév az eredménynek felel meg.
text.en: The third conditional talks about the past, which can no longer change: if + past perfect, would have + participle. “If I had known, I would have called you.” The Spanish “Si lo hubiera sabido, te habría llamado” has the same structure: hubiera + participle matches the if-clause, and habría + participle matches the result.
text.es: El tercer condicional habla del pasado, que ya no se puede cambiar: if + past perfect, would have + participio. «If I had known, I would have called you.» (Si lo hubiera sabido, te habría llamado.) El «Si lo hubiera sabido, te habría llamado» del español tiene la misma estructura: hubiera + participio corresponde a la cláusula con if, y habría + participio corresponde al resultado.
text.de: Das dritte Konditional spricht über die Vergangenheit, die sich nicht mehr ändern lässt: if + Past Perfect, would have + Partizip. „If I had known, I would have called you.“ (Hätte ich es gewusst, hätte ich dich angerufen.) Das spanische „Si lo hubiera sabido, te habría llamado“ hat dieselbe Struktur: hubiera + Partizip entspricht dem if-Satz, habría + Partizip dem Ergebnis.

rows: el auxiliar en la cláusula con if
el resultado en el presente (condicional mixto)

title.hu: A szerkezet: if + past perfect, would have + igenév
title.en: The structure: if + past perfect, would have + participle
title.es: La estructura: if + past perfect, would have + participio
title.de: Die Struktur: if + Past Perfect, would have + Partizip

text.hu: Az if-mondatban had + igenév áll, az eredményben would have + igenév. A két rész felcserélhető; ha az if-mondat áll elöl, vessző kell utána.
text.en: The if-clause has had + participle, the result has would have + participle. The two parts can swap; if the if-clause comes first, a comma follows it.
text.es: La cláusula con if lleva had + participio, el resultado lleva would have + participio. Las dos partes pueden cambiar de lugar; si la cláusula con if va primero, lleva coma.
text.de: Der if-Satz hat had + Partizip, das Ergebnis would have + Partizip. Die beiden Teile können getauscht werden; steht der if-Satz vorn, folgt ein Komma.

examples.es: If she had studied, she would have passed.

tr.de: Hätte sie gelernt, hätte sie bestanden.

examples.es: I would have called you if I had known.

tr.es: Te habría llamado si lo hubiera sabido.

text.hu: Tagadás: hadn’t + igenév az if-mondatban, wouldn’t have + igenév az eredményben. Lehetőségnél could have vagy might have is állhat.
text.en: Negatives: hadn’t + participle in the if-clause, wouldn’t have + participle in the result. For a possibility, could have or might have can stand.
text.es: Negativos: hadn’t + participio en la cláusula con if, wouldn’t have + participio en el resultado. Para una posibilidad pueden ir could have o might have.
text.de: Verneinung: hadn’t + Partizip im if-Satz, wouldn’t have + Partizip im Ergebnis. Für eine Möglichkeit können could have oder might have stehen.

title.hu: Vegyes feltételes: múltbeli feltétel, jelenbeli eredmény
title.en: Mixed conditional: a past condition, a present result
title.es: Condicional mixto: una condición pasada, un resultado presente
title.de: Gemischtes Konditional: eine vergangene Bedingung, ein gegenwärtiges Ergebnis

text.hu: Ha a feltétel a múltra vonatkozik, de az eredmény a mostanra, az eredmény would + alapige: „If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.”
text.en: If the condition is about the past but the result is about now, the result is would + base verb: “If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.”
text.es: Si la condición es del pasado pero el resultado es de ahora, el resultado es would + verbo base: «If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.»
text.de: Wenn die Bedingung die Vergangenheit betrifft, das Ergebnis aber das Jetzt, ist das Ergebnis would + Grundform: „If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.“

text.hu: Az if elhagyható, ha a had az alany elé kerül: „Had I known, I would have called.” Jelentése ugyanaz, mint az „If I had known…” mondaté.
text.en: The if can be dropped if had goes before the subject: “Had I known, I would have called.” It means the same as “If I had known…”.
text.es: Se puede quitar el if si had va antes del sujeto: «Had I known, I would have called.» Significa lo mismo que «If I had known…».
text.de: Das if kann wegfallen, wenn had vor das Subjekt rückt: „Had I known, I would have called.“ Es bedeutet dasselbe wie „If I had known…“.

examples.es: Had I known, I would have called.

tr.en: Had I known, I would have called.

text.hu: Az if-mondatban nincs would have: nem „If I would have known”, hanem „If I had known”. A would have az eredménymondatba kerül.
text.en: There is no would have in the if-clause: not “If I would have known”, but “If I had known”. Would have goes in the result clause.
text.es: En la cláusula con if no va would have: no «If I would have known», sino «If I had known». Would have va en la cláusula del resultado.
text.de: Im if-Satz steht kein would have: nicht „If I would have known“, sondern „If I had known“. Would have steht im Ergebnissatz.

text.hu: A would have + igenév mindig azt jelenti, hogy nem történt meg. Ha csak lehetséges volt, de bizonytalan, might have áll; ha a képesség volt meg, could have.
text.en: Would have + participle always means it did not happen. If it was only possible but uncertain, might have is used; if the ability was there, could have.
text.es: Would have + participio siempre significa que no ocurrió. Si solo era posible pero incierto, se usa might have; si estaba la capacidad, could have.
text.de: Would have + Partizip heißt immer, dass es nicht geschah. War es nur möglich, aber unsicher, steht might have; war die Fähigkeit da, could have.

speak.hu: A harmadik feltételes mód a múltról szól, ami már nem változtatható. Az «if» mondatban «had» plusz igenév áll, az eredményben «would have» plusz igenév: «If I had known, I would have called you». Tagadásban «hadn't» és «wouldn't have». A vegyes feltételesnél a feltétel múltbeli, az eredmény mostani: «If I had taken that job, I would be rich now». Formális változata: «Had I known, I would have called».
speak.en: The third conditional talks about the past, which can no longer change. The «if» clause has «had» plus the participle, the result has «would have» plus the participle: «If I had known, I would have called you». In the negative: «hadn't» and «wouldn't have». In the mixed conditional the condition is in the past and the result is now: «If I had taken that job, I would be rich now». The formal version is «Had I known, I would have called».
speak.es: El tercer condicional habla del pasado, que ya no se puede cambiar. La cláusula con «if» lleva «had» más participio, y el resultado lleva «would have» más participio: «If I had known, I would have called you». En negativo: «hadn't» y «wouldn't have». En el condicional mixto la condición es del pasado y el resultado es de ahora: «If I had taken that job, I would be rich now». La versión formal es «Had I known, I would have called».
speak.de: Das dritte Konditional spricht über die Vergangenheit, die sich nicht mehr ändern lässt. Der «if»-Satz hat «had» plus Partizip, das Ergebnis hat «would have» plus Partizip: «If I had known, I would have called you». In der Verneinung: «hadn't» und «wouldn't have». Beim gemischten Konditional liegt die Bedingung in der Vergangenheit und das Ergebnis im Jetzt: «If I had taken that job, I would be rich now». Die formelle Variante ist «Had I known, I would have called».

didn't.en: “Didn’t have lied” does not exist; after have a participle is needed, and the result takes wouldn’t.
didn't.es: «Didn’t have lied» no existe; después de have hace falta un participio, y el resultado lleva wouldn’t.
didn't.de: „Didn’t have lied“ gibt es nicht; nach have braucht man ein Partizip, und das Ergebnis nimmt wouldn’t.

examples: She wouldn't have said that.
I wouldn't have gone.

items.sentence: If I ___ so tired, I would have gone with you.

why.hu: Az if-mondatban hadn’t + igenév áll: if I hadn’t been.
why.en: The if-clause has hadn’t + participle: if I hadn’t been.
why.es: La cláusula con if lleva hadn’t + participio: if I hadn’t been.
why.de: Der if-Satz hat hadn’t + Partizip: if I hadn’t been.

wouldn't have been.hu: A wouldn’t have been az eredménymondat alakja; az if-mondatban hadn’t kell.
wouldn't have been.en: Wouldn’t have been is the form of the result clause; the if-clause needs hadn’t.
wouldn't have been.es: Wouldn’t have been es la forma de la cláusula del resultado; la cláusula con if necesita hadn’t.
wouldn't have been.de: Wouldn’t have been ist die Form des Ergebnissatzes; der if-Satz braucht hadn’t.

haven't been.hu: A haven’t been present perfect; a would have gone múltbeli eredmény mellé hadn’t been kell.
haven't been.en: Haven’t been is the present perfect; next to the past result would have gone you need hadn’t been.
haven't been.es: Haven’t been es el presente perfecto; junto al resultado pasado would have gone hace falta hadn’t been.
haven't been.de: Haven’t been ist das Present Perfect; neben dem vergangenen Ergebnis would have gone braucht man hadn’t been.

examples: If I hadn't seen it, I wouldn't believe it.
If she hadn't called, I would have left.

items.sentence: If I had been born in Mexico, I ___ speak Spanish now.

why.hu: Vegyes feltételes: jelenbeli eredmény (now): would + alapige.
why.en: Mixed conditional: a present result (now): would + base verb.
why.es: Condicional mixto: un resultado presente (now): would + verbo base.
why.de: Gemischtes Konditional: ein gegenwärtiges Ergebnis (now): would + Grundform.

would have.hu: A would have speak nem létezik; a have után igenév kell, és a now jelenre vonatkozik, ezért would speak kell.
would have.en: “Would have speak” does not exist; after have you need a participle, and now refers to the present, so you need would speak.
would have.es: «Would have speak» no existe; después de have hace falta un participio, y now se refiere al presente, por eso hace falta would speak.
would have.de: „Would have speak“ gibt es nicht; nach have braucht man ein Partizip, und now bezieht sich auf die Gegenwart, deshalb braucht man would speak.

had.hu: A had speak nem létezik; a would a jelenbeli eredmény segédigéje.
had.en: “Had speak” does not exist; would is the helper verb of the present result.
had.es: «Had speak» no existe; would es el verbo auxiliar del resultado presente.
had.de: „Had speak“ gibt es nicht; would ist das Hilfsverb des gegenwärtigen Ergebnisses.

examples: If I had studied, I would know it now.
If she had stayed, she would live here now.

have given.de: Have given ist das Present Perfect; neben dem vergangenen Ergebnis would have bought braucht man had given.

would have given.hu: A would have az eredménymondat alakja; az if-mondatban had kell.
would have given.en: Would have is the form of the result clause; the if-clause needs had.
would have given.es: Would have es la forma de la cláusula del resultado; la cláusula con if necesita had.

items.sentence: If you ___ me, I would have taken the other road.

why.es: La cláusula con if lleva had + participio: if you had told.

have told.hu: A have told present perfect; a would have taken múltbeli eredmény mellé had told kell.

have told.de: Have told ist das Present Perfect; neben dem vergangenen Ergebnis would have taken braucht man had told.

would tell.hu: A would tell nem állhat az if után; az if-mondatban had + igenév kell.
would tell.en: Would tell cannot follow if; the if-clause needs had + participle.
would tell.es: Would tell no puede ir después de if; la cláusula con if necesita had + participio.

items.sentence: If she had called earlier, we ___ have solved the problem.

why.hu: Lehetőség a múltban: could have + igenév.
why.en: A possibility in the past: could have + participle.
why.es: Una posibilidad en el pasado: could have + participio.
why.de: Eine Möglichkeit in der Vergangenheit: could have + Partizip.

can.hu: A can have solved nem illik a múltbeli lehetőséghez; could have kell.
can.en: Can have solved does not fit a past possibility; you need could have.
can.es: Can have solved no cabe en una posibilidad pasada; hace falta could have.
can.de: Can have solved passt nicht zu einer vergangenen Möglichkeit; man braucht could have.

had.hu: A had have solved nem létezik; az eredménymondatban could have áll.
had.en: “Had have solved” does not exist; the result clause takes could have.
had.es: «Had have solved» no existe; la cláusula del resultado lleva could have.
had.de: „Had have solved“ gibt es nicht; der Ergebnissatz nimmt could have.

examples: If I had asked, I could have helped.
If he had tried, he could have won.

items.person: el auxiliar en la cláusula con if
el resultado en el presente (condicional mixto)

items.es: If I had known, I would have called you.

tr.en: If I had known, I would have called you.
tr.es: Si lo hubiera sabido, te habría llamado.
tr.de: Hätte ich es gewusst, hätte ich dich angerufen.

text.hu: valós lehetőség a jövőben
text.en: a real possibility in the future
text.es: una posibilidad real en el futuro
text.de: eine reale Möglichkeit in der Zukunft

wrong.hu: A had known nem jövőre vonatkozik, hanem a múltra; a valós jövőhöz present simple kell.
wrong.en: Had known is not about the future but about the past; a real future needs the present simple.
wrong.es: Had known no trata del futuro sino del pasado; un futuro real necesita el presente simple.
wrong.de: Had known betrifft nicht die Zukunft, sondern die Vergangenheit; eine reale Zukunft braucht das Present Simple.

text.hu: valószínűtlen helyzet a jelenben
text.en: an unlikely situation now
text.es: una situación poco probable ahora
text.de: eine unwahrscheinliche Situation jetzt

wrong.hu: A jelenbeli, valószínűtlen helyzethez past simple kell; a had known a múltra utal.
wrong.en: An unlikely situation now needs the past simple; had known points to the past.
wrong.es: Una situación poco probable ahora necesita el pasado simple; had known apunta al pasado.
wrong.de: Eine unwahrscheinliche Situation jetzt braucht das Past Simple; had known verweist auf die Vergangenheit.

text.hu: valótlan helyzet a múltban: past perfect
text.en: an unreal situation in the past: past perfect
text.es: una situación irreal en el pasado: past perfect
text.de: eine irreale Situation in der Vergangenheit: Past Perfect

text.hu: jövőbeli terv

wrong.hu: A would have called nem terv; azt jelzi, hogy a hívás nem történt meg.
wrong.en: Would have called is not a plan; it shows that the call did not happen.
wrong.es: Would have called no es un plan; muestra que la llamada no ocurrió.

text.hu: múltbeli szokás

wrong.hu: A múltbeli szokáshoz used to vagy would + alapige kell; a would have called egyszeri, nem megtörtént esetet jelöl.
wrong.en: A past habit needs used to or would + base verb; would have called marks a single case that did not happen.
wrong.es: Un hábito pasado necesita used to o would + verbo base; would have called marca un caso único que no ocurrió.
wrong.de: Eine vergangene Gewohnheit braucht used to oder would + Grundform; would have called markiert einen einzelnen Fall, der nicht geschah.

tr.es: Si hubiera tomado ese trabajo, ahora sería rico.
tr.de: Hätte ich den Job genommen, wäre ich jetzt reich.

text.hu: harmadik feltételes: mindkét rész múltbeli
text.en: third conditional: both parts are in the past
text.es: tercer condicional: las dos partes son del pasado
text.de: drittes Konditional: beide Teile liegen in der Vergangenheit

wrong.hu: A would be a mostanra vonatkozik (now), ezért nem tisztán harmadik feltételes.
wrong.en: Would be refers to now, so it is not a pure third conditional.
wrong.es: Would be se refiere a ahora (now), por eso no es un tercer condicional puro.
wrong.de: Would be bezieht sich auf das Jetzt (now), deshalb ist es kein reines drittes Konditional.

text.hu: vegyes feltételes: múltbeli feltétel, jelenbeli eredmény
text.en: mixed: a past condition, a present result
text.es: mixto: una condición pasada, un resultado presente
text.de: gemischt: eine vergangene Bedingung, ein gegenwärtiges Ergebnis

text.hu: második feltételes: mindkét rész jelenbeli
text.en: second conditional: both parts are in the present
text.es: segundo condicional: las dos partes son del presente
text.de: zweites Konditional: beide Teile liegen in der Gegenwart

wrong.hu: A had taken a múltra utal; a második feltételesben past simple állna az if-mondatban.
wrong.en: Had taken points to the past; the second conditional would have the past simple in the if-clause.
wrong.es: Had taken apunta al pasado; el segundo condicional tendría el pasado simple en la cláusula con if.
wrong.de: Had taken verweist auf die Vergangenheit; das zweite Konditional hätte das Past Simple im if-Satz.
